name: deployit
description: On-tailnet OTA deploys for iOS, macOS, and visionOS apps. Archives, signs, and serves Development-method builds from each Mac via Tailscale Serve; cross-machine shared listing rendered from a git-backed index. Semver-aware: reports the project's semver version when the semver plugin is active, and bumps it on deploy when it has not changed since the last build.
